display.purpose: The stock-detail page's headline price — the largest, most weighted text in the system, and the only 'display' moment given to a number rather than a headline.

headline.purpose: The traded symbol on the detail page (e.g. COMI).

body.purpose: Table cells, copy, buttons, search input — anything a human wrote.

label.purpose: Uppercase-tracked micro-labels: table headers, badges, stat labels, the tape tag.

motion.name: tape-scroll
motion.purpose: The ticker tape's continuous marquee loop; duplicated content makes the loop seamless.

motion.name: price-flash
motion.purpose: Fires on every Price Cell value change — the system's primary 'something just happened' signal. Kept brief and non-repeating.

motion.name: tape-held-pause
motion.purpose: Freezes and desaturates the ticker tape when the connection is stale, with a fading 'TAPE HELD' overlay label.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Inverted-color call-to-action: active filter pill, active timeframe tab, banner/empty-state CTAs (Retry now, Reconnect, Clear search).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; background: var(--tckr-color-text, #f2f1ee); color: var(--tckr-color-surface, #0c0d0e); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tckr-color-accent, #3fd79c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Pill
components.description: Inactive filter/preset pill — becomes the Primary Action Button's color pair on selection, never on hover.
components.css: .ds-pill { font: inherit; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--tckr-color-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); background: transparent; color: var(--tckr-color-text-muted, #9296a0); cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tckr-color-accent, #3fd79c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill--active { background: var(--tckr-color-text, #f2f1ee); color: var(--tckr-color-surface, #0c0d0e); border-color: var(--tckr-color-text, #f2f1ee); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Live Badge
components.description: The system's assertion that a stream is LIVE — sourced only from server entitlement, never a client default.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge--live { color: var(--tckr-color-up, #3fd79c); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-up, #3fd79c) 14%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-up, #3fd79c) 30%, transparent); } .ds-badge__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Delayed Badge
components.description: Marks a DELAYED stream with its simulated offset — always labelled as a simulation artifact, never presented as the real 15-minute delay.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge--delayed { color: var(--tckr-color-warning, #d9a441); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-warning, #d9a441) 13%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-warning, #d9a441) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Price Cell
components.description: The one component every price/signed decimal renders through. Flashes a 900ms directional pulse on value change; shows a de-emphasized italic state before the first tick.
components.css: .ds-price-cell { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-price-cell--muted { color: var(--tckr-color-text-muted, #9296a0); font-style: italic; } .ds-price-cell__flash { display: inline-block; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 2px; margin: 0 -2px; } .ds-price-cell__flash--up { animation: ds-flash-up 900ms ease-out; } .ds-price-cell__flash--down { animation: ds-flash-down 900ms ease-out; } @keyframes ds-flash-up { from { background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-up, #3fd79c) 28%, transparent); } to { background-color: transparent; } } @keyframes ds-flash-down { from { background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-down, #f2705f) 28%, transparent); } to { background-color: transparent; } }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: One cell in the detail page's OHLC/volume/lot/tick grid — hairline-separated, tonal, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: var(--tckr-color-surface-raised, #17181a); padding: 12px; } .ds-stat__label { display: block; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--tckr-color-text-muted, #9296a0); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stat__value { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--tckr-color-text, #f2f1ee); }

components.name: Connection Banner
components.description: Tinted, bordered alert for a reconnecting/closed data stream, with an inverted-color retry action.
components.html:
◴
The stream dropped — retrying in 4s
Attempt 1. Prices below are the last values received.
components.css: .ds-conn-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 9px; } .ds-conn-banner--warning { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-warning, #d9a441) 9%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--tckr-color-warning, #d9a441) 26%, transparent); } .ds-conn-banner__icon { font-size: 15px; color: var(--tckr-color-warning, #d9a441); } .ds-conn-banner__title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--tckr-color-text, #f2f1ee); } .ds-conn-banner__detail { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--tckr-color-text-muted, #9296a0); } .ds-btn-primary { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; background: var(--tckr-color-text, #f2f1ee); color: var(--tckr-color-surface, #0c0d0e); cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview: Tckr Market Watch reads like a professional trading terminal built for a dim room, not a consumer finance app. The page opens dark by construction — data-theme="dark" is hard-coded on <html>, so this is the software's resting state, not a toggle a user finds later. Every surface is near-black and bordered rather than shadowed; every number is set in a monospace face with tabular figures so a column of prices lines up like a ledger; a scrolling ticker tape and per-row sparklines give the page a pulse without ever becoming its subject. The two signal colors that matter — Terminal Mint for "up" and "live," Alert Coral for "down" — never appear as decoration; they only ever mark a real state change, and they never appear alone: a ▲/▼ glyph rides with every colored delta so the meaning survives for a colorblind viewer. Nothing in this system uses a shadow, a gradient (beyond the tape's edge-fade mask), or a solid saturated fill outside of a badge/pill — depth comes from tone (surface vs. surface-raised) and hairline borders, never elevation. The system is quietly technical and unhurried: motion exists (the tape's 32-second loop, a 900ms price-flash pulse) but is calm and rhythmic, never urgent or flashy — it earns trust by looking like an instrument, not a toy.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-by-default, not dark-as-option — the light theme is a plain daytime fallback for an explicit override, not the primary experience.
Every number is monospace with tabular figures; every UI label/heading is Archivo. The two faces never swap roles.
Color never carries meaning alone — every up/down signal pairs a color with a ▲/▼ glyph.
Flat by construction: zero box-shadow anywhere in the codebase. Depth is tonal layering plus 1px hairline borders.
Status surfaces (LIVE, DELAYED, warnings, errors) are always a translucent tint over the base surface (color-mix, 9–14% strength), never a solid fill.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Glyph Rule
rules.body: No price direction is ever shown by color alone. Every .tckr-delta--up/.tckr-delta--down pairs its color with a leading ▲/▼ glyph, so the ~1-in-12 colorblind viewer still reads the direction. This is a hard product requirement, not a style preference.

rules.name: The Tinted-Never-Solid Rule
rules.body: A status surface (LIVE/DELAYED badges, the simulated banner, connection warning/danger banners) is always its accent color mixed into the base surface at 9–14% strength, bordered at roughly double that strength. A solid accent fill is reserved for the inverted primary-button/active-pill pattern only.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-For-Machines Rule
rules.body: Anything a machine produced or a user would compare digit-by-digit is set in Roboto Mono with tabular-nums. Anything a human wrote is Archivo. The two never trade places.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: This system conveys "this is a distinct surface" with a border and/or a tone shift, never a shadow. A future component that reaches for box-shadow has left the system.

dos: Do pair every colored delta with its ▲/▼ glyph — never color alone.
Do render every status surface as a color-mix tint at 9–14% strength, bordered at roughly double that strength — never a solid accent fill.
Do route every displayed price or signed decimal through Price Cell.
Do keep Roboto Mono for anything numeric or machine-read and Archivo for anything a human wrote.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Border hairline or a tone shift — never a shadow.
donts: Don't introduce a box-shadow anywhere — this system has none, by construction.
Don't give a status badge or banner a solid, fully-opaque accent background.
Don't let a decorative element (the ticker tape, a sparkline) become a second source of truth for a price.
Don't shorten the 900ms price-flash duration or swap its ease-out timing without checking it still reads as "quietly technical, unhurried."
Don't use a 0px (sharp) corner anywhere — the system's radius floor is 2px.
Don't treat the dark theme as optional chrome — it is the shipped default, not the design's secondary expression.
